content:
I'm assuming your using pop protocol to some degree or a mix across devices.

On your read status question, have you also unticked "mark as read when opened" from TB-A settings > account name > reading mail. This could be the reason for some emails showing as read on your desktop.

The app doesn't support any auto deletion or setting to maintain a rolling fixed number of emails

You can raise this as a feature suggestion on Mozilla connect where the community can vote for it.

There has been requests from the community for filtering capability. Perhaps a rule based filter could have some overlap with your own needs if developed.

https://connect.mozilla.org/t5/ideas/filtering-with-android-thunderbird/idi-p/61144
